description: Public Tool Plaza service manifest for local configuration. It records service roles, default ports and environment variables without private data paths, credentials or database files.

services.name: ehr
services.role: Synthetic or site-local EHR adapter endpoint
services.public_start: Set EHR_START_COMMAND to a local non-public service command if you have one.

services.name: similar-case
services.role: Synthetic or site-local similar-case retrieval endpoint
services.public_start: Set SIMILAR_CASE_START_COMMAND to a local non-public service command if you have one.

services.name: knowledge-graph
services.role: Public Tool Plaza API server for retained knowledge-tool interfaces
services.public_start: bash tool_plaza/bone_tools_api/start_server.sh or the equivalent repo-relative uvicorn command used by tool_plaza/start_all_services.sh

services.name: medrag-translate
services.role: Optional local translation endpoint used by retrieval pipelines
services.public_start: Set MEDRAG_TRANSLATE_START_COMMAND to a local non-public service command if you have one.

services.name: medrag
services.public_start: Set MEDRAG_START_COMMAND to a local non-public service command if you have one.

services.name: pmc-patients
services.public_start: Set PMC_PATIENTS_START_COMMAND to a local non-public service command if you have one.

services.name: fathom-search
services.public_start: Set FATHOM_SEARCH_START_COMMAND to a local non-public service command if you have one.

services.name: qwen3-vllm
services.role: Optional OpenAI-compatible local vLLM model endpoint
services.public_start: Set VLLM_START_COMMAND to your local vLLM command if you have model weights.
